| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| date | TEXT NOT NULL | ECB publication date in YYYY-MM-DD form. |
| currency | TEXT NOT NULL | Three-letter uppercase currency code. |
| rate | TEXT NOT NULL | ECB-published rate text, preserved exactly. |
| id | INTEGER PK | Surrogate primary key. |

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== AC rate-upsert ===
Intent: A rate written through the declared repository operation can be read back with its supplied values.

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    date = "2099-12-30"
    currency = "ZZQ"
    rate = "1.23450"
    db.rates.upsert(date=date, currency=currency, rate=rate)
    row = db.rates.get(date=date, currency=currency)
    assert row is not None
    assert (row.date, row.currency, row.rate) == (date, currency, rate)
=== END AC rate-upsert ===

=== AC rate-delete ===
Intent: Deleting a rate removes the row identified by its supplied key.

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    date = "2099-12-30"
    currency = "ZZR"
    rate = "2.5"
    db.rates.upsert(date=date, currency=currency, rate=rate)
    deleted = db.rates.delete(date=date, currency=currency)
    row = db.rates.get(date=date, currency=currency)
    assert deleted is not None
    assert row is None
=== END AC rate-delete ===
